main_measure.name: OLS slope of forward 24-bar return minus window mean, on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm if slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject if slope < 0 with t <= -2; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: two-proportion z: share of positive 24-bar returns, forecast > 0 vs all sampled bars

decided_by: Inconclusive: the slope's t lies between -2 and 2.
reading: The window's mean 24-bar return is taken as the mean forward 24-bar return over that window's non-overlapping sampled bars (grid 0, 24, 48, ... with a full forward window), the slope's t is the OLS t on the pooled samples, and the supporting check, which has no threshold in the plan, counts as passed when z >= 1.96.
